summary: CRC32 computation over a byte buffer. Bitwise table-driven CRC using the 256-entry table at dword_5AFFA0, with an unrolled 8-byte fast path and a byte-at-a-time tail loop. The caller-supplied seed is complemented on entry and the running CRC is complemented on return, so chained CRC computation (passing the previous result as the next seed) is supported. Invoked by AnimationHandleAlloc and sub_517F58.

local_names.crc: running CRC state, seeded with the complement of the input CRC value

operations.description: If the buffer pointer a2 is null, return 0 immediately.
Seed the running CRC with the bitwise complement of the input CRC value a1.
While at least 8 bytes remain, process 8 bytes per iteration using an unrolled sequence of table-driven CRC steps; each step is crc_table[(crc XOR input byte) AND 255] XOR (crc >> 8).
Apply one table-driven CRC byte step against dword_5AFFA0, XORing the table entry with the CRC shifted right by 8 bits.
Process the remaining bytes one at a time with the same table-driven CRC step.
Return the bitwise complement of the final running CRC.

unresolved: The CRC polynomial and the initialization of dword_5AFFA0 are external to this function; only the table lookups are visible here.
